title: AdS Black Holes Are Short-Lived inside the Spectral Form Factor
summary: We analyze the contribution of AdS black hole saddles to the spectral form factor of $d$-dimensional CFTs with a gravity dual. At high temperatures, the analytically continued gravitational action of the large AdS black hole is expected to give a leading large-$N$ approximation to the 'slope' of the spectral form factor. When the CFT is put on a $(d-1)$-dimensional spatial sphere of radius $\ell$, we show that such an evaluation implies unphysical behavior of $Z(β+it)$ at large $t\gg \ell$ for $d\equiv5 \,({\rm mod}\; 4)$.
